# #1871: Patch: Stinkyscape S23, Alteran Reach
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape set, a card part. It builds on `main` behind R1420's gate, so no player meets these cards before the release, the last part of #1856.

## Scope

- **Cards**: `#148` Alteran Reach, `#148.1` Edge of the Universe
- **Uses, already on `main`**: #1847, #1843

Edge of the Universe is a win for its player and a draw for the opponent; on its Radiant face the player chooses a draw or a loss for the opponent (the designer's answer).

## Reading

Each card's entry is in the foundation's card-by-card brief (`docs/stinkyscape-set.md` once #1857 has merged); the designer's words are `JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md`. The plan's fixes (ST8) and the designer's answers (ST9) win over the designer's words.

## Done when

- Each card's script, `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/cNNN_slug.rs` (filling the foundation's stub), returns `Vec<Effect>` built from the engine's verbs and reads state through the prelude alone (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6), with tests in the same file for its base and its Radiant behaviour and its BUILD M12 rows green.
- A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (`crates/cards/README.md`); a decision the spec does not make gets a ruling note from this issue's block (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
- The cards' own rows (§8.10, §7, BUILD M12, `docs/radiant-audit.md`, the catalog entry) are corrected where the build decides otherwise, and the pull request says so.
- The set stays held by R1420's gate: no pending fragment, no golden trace moves, the shipped totals unchanged.
- The gates: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `fuzz --seeds 200`.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/docs/stinkyscape-set.md) (ST6, ST8, ST9); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy` until they merge; where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md).

Blocked by #1857

## Plan

_Written by `claude-5` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40445014084)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Replace the foundation's stubs for Stinkyscape #148 Alteran Reach and #148.1 Edge of the Universe with real scripts, built only from engine verbs that are already on `main`. Reach uses `subsystems::starscape_abilities` (R1847000–R1847002) plus the Quickdraw flag. Edge uses `flee`, and on its Radiant face a `choose_mode` prompt first (R1843002–R1843004). Each file gets tests for its base face, its Radiant face and its BUILD M12 row, and both catalog entries get their `loc`.

The set stays held behind R1420's gate:
- no pending fragment;
- no golden trace moves;
- the totals don't change.

The fuzz tool deals held sets. Once the Reach works, a random game can reach the edge and cast the Edge. So the fuzz's list of endings must accept `fled` and `fled-decisive`, as the Meditative build once added `alt-win` and `won-by-effect` (#652).

No new verb, board fact or ruling is needed. §8.10 and §7 already say what the build does, and so do BUILD M12, `docs/radiant-audit.md` and the catalog text, so none of those rows changes. The PR says so.

## Files to touch

| Path | new/change | What |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c148_alteran_reach.rs` | change | header comment, `EDGE_OF_THE_UNIVERSE`, `alteran_reach(radiant)`, `script()`, `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c148_1_edge_of_the_universe.rs` | change | header comment, `DRAW`, `LOSS`, `STEP_FLEE`, `script()`, `mod tests` |
| `crates/cards/catalog.json` | change | `"loc"` of `stinkyscape-148` (line 24347) and `stinkyscape-148-1` (line 24380), and nothing else |
| `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` | change | `TERMINAL_REASONS` and its doc comment, plus one test in `tests::fuzz_m4_gate` |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/endings.rs` | change | header lines 6–7, plus one new `mod` at the end with a test that uses the real card |

**Do not touch:**
- `spec/` (no new ruling, and no `proven_in` edit);
- `BUILD.md`, `docs/`, `apps/`, `crates/engine/`, `crates/ai/src/`;
- `crates/cards/patches/`, any other catalog field;
- `chinese.json`, `flavour.json`, `card-audio.json5`;
- the engine fixtures (`crates/engine/tests/rules/fixtures/{starscape,endings}.rs`).

**Governing rules:**
- §6.1 Indestructible (R46);
- §6.2 Quickdraw (R640);
- §6.3 starscape map and Escape the Universe;
- §8.10 row 148 and §7 row 148.1;
- R1847000–R1847002, R1843002–R1843004, R850, R44, R79, R1420, R1857000.

## Steps

1. **Reach script** (`c148_alteran_reach.rs`), above the tests.
   - Header `//!`: keep line 1. Replace the `STUB (#1857)` lines with the Base/Radiant/Engine shape that `meditative/c080_aluneth.rs` uses:
     - quote both faces' catalog text;
     - "Engine:": Indestructible is a catalog keyword (R46); Quickdraw is the static flag `setup.rs` reads (R640); the travel is `subsystems::starscape_abilities` (R1847000–R1847002), with the map belonging to the player; the 20th travel adds S #148.1 on its base face and a full hand burns it; Radiant makes the first travel each turn free; the card declares no numbers.
   - Then add:
   ```rust
   use jackioh_engine::prelude::*;

   pub const ID: &str = "stinkyscape-148";

   /// S #148.1 Edge of the Universe, the card the map's edge adds (R1847001).
   const EDGE_OF_THE_UNIVERSE: &str = "stinkyscape-148-1";

   fn alteran_reach(radiant: bool) -> Script {
       Script {
           // R640: dealt in the opening hand in place of a draw.
           static_flags: Some(StaticFlags { quickdraw: Some(true), ..StaticFlags::default() }),
           // R1847002: the paid travel; on the Radiant face a free first travel each turn switches with it.
           activations: subsystems::starscape_abilities(radiant, EDGE_OF_THE_UNIVERSE),
           ..Script::default()
       }
   }

   pub fn script() -> CardScripts {
       CardScripts { base: alteran_reach(false), radiant: alteran_reach(true) }
   }
   ```

2. **Edge script** (`c148_1_edge_of_the_universe.rs`).
   - Header in the same shape. "Engine:" says:
     - Escape the Universe is `flee` (R1843002), taking hold at the closing state check, a hero at 0 losing first (R850);
     - a `fled` game is a win for the caster and a draw for the other player (R1843004);
     - Radiant asks a `mode` prompt as it resolves (R1843003), and a loss ends it `fled-decisive`;
     - it declares no numbers.
   - Then add:
   ```rust
   use jackioh_engine::prelude::*;

   pub const ID: &str = "stinkyscape-148-1";

   /// R1843003: the Radiant face's two answers, what the flight leaves the other player. The client
   /// already translates both words (zh-CN.json), and the prompt keeps its default "Choose one".
   const DRAW: &str = "Draw";
   const LOSS: &str = "Loss";
   /// The step the answer resumes at (§10.6).
   const STEP_FLEE: &str = "flee";

   pub fn script() -> CardScripts {
       let base = Script {
           cry: Some(hook(|_ctx| vec![flee(FleeArgs::default())])),
           ..Script::default()
       };
       let radiant = Script {
           cry: Some(hook(|_ctx| {
               vec![choose_mode(json_as(json!({ "options": [DRAW, LOSS], "step": STEP_FLEE })))]
           })),
           resume: IndexMap::from([(
               STEP_FLEE,
               hook(|ctx| {
                   let opponent = match chosen_options(ctx).first().map(String::as_str) {
                       Some(LOSS) => FleeOpponent::Loss,
                       _ => FleeOpponent::Draw,
                   };
                   vec![flee(FleeArgs { player: None, opponent: Some(opponent) })]
               }),
           )]),
           ..Script::default()
       };
       CardScripts { base, radiant }
   }
   ```

3. **Reach tests.**
   - Above `#[cfg(test)]`, add a `//` comment that quotes BUILD M12 row S 148 (the layout `c080_aluneth.rs` uses).
   - `mod tests` starts with these imports:
     - `use super::{EDGE_OF_THE_UNIVERSE, ID, script};`
     - `use jackioh_engine::subsystems::starscape::{STARSCAPE_FREE_TRAVEL_ABILITY, STARSCAPE_TRAVEL_ABILITY, starscape_amount};`
     - `use jackioh_engine::testkit::*;`
     - `const P1`
   - Copy these helpers from `crates/engine/tests/rules/starscape.rs`, renaming as follows:
     - `board_with`: drop `register_starscape_fixtures()`, build with `crate::scenario`, def `ID`, libraries `crate::filler(20)` and `crate::filler(4)`, p1 `"mana": 4`, p2 `"health": 100`, both `auto_end_turn = Some(false)`;
     - `board`, `heal_path`, `set_map` and `at` as they are;
     - the travel helper becomes `fn travel(s) { s.activate(ID, json!({})) }`;
     - `mana`, `travelled`, `activations_in`/`activations` and `legal_abilities` as they are;
     - `in_hand` returns the `CardInstance` for the Edge: `Option<CardInstance>`, found by `def_id == EDGE_OF_THE_UNIVERSE`.
   - Tests (listed under Tests) go in `mod s148_alteran_reach { mod base {…} mod radiant {…} }`.

4. **Edge tests.**
   - Comment quoting BUILD row S 148.1, then `mod tests` with `use super::{ID, LOSS, DRAW, script};`, `use jackioh_engine::testkit::*;`, `P1`/`P2`.
   - Helper `cast(seed, radiant) -> Scenario`:
     - `crate::scenario(json!({"seed": seed, "p1": {"hand": [{"def": ID, "radiant": radiant}, "core-005"], "library": crate::filler(4)}, "p2": {"field": ["core-008"], "hand": ["core-005"], "library": crate::filler(4)}}))`;
     - then `s.play(ID, json!({}))`.
   - Copy `result_of`, `flights` and `tail` from `crates/engine/tests/rules/endings.rs` lines 87–106, and `answers` from line 553.
   - Add `/// … (losing health is not damage, R18)` `const LETHAL: i32 = 100 * HERO_HEALTH;`.
   - Add `lethal_then_escape(s: &mut Scenario)` by copying `trap_hits_enemy_hero` in `meditative_plus/c007_life_mage.rs`:
     - the running card is the Edge in p1's hand, with controller P1;
     - the list is `vec![jackioh_engine::effects::lose_health(json_as(json!({"player": "self", "amount": LETHAL})))]` followed by `(script().base.cry.expect("the cry"))(&mut ctx)`;
     - apply it with `apply_effects`, then `settle`.
   - Tests go in `mod s148_1_edge_of_the_universe { mod base, mod radiant }`, as listed under Tests.

5. **Fuzz** (`crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`).
   - In `TERMINAL_REASONS`, after `"voided"`, add `"fled",` and `"fled-decisive",`.
   - Doc comment: after "a Glitch that voids the match (R679)", add "and Stinkyscape #148.1 Edge of the Universe's flight (R1843002)".
   - In `mod fuzz_m4_gate`, after `r679_a_glitch_that_voids_the_match_is_a_real_ending`, copy that test as `r1843002_a_flight_is_a_real_ending`. Loop over `[GameOverReason::Fled, GameOverReason::FledDecisive]`, with `winner: Winner::P1`, and add `reason.as_str()` to the assert message.

6. **AI test** (`crates/ai/tests/ai/endings.rs`).
   - Lines 6–7 become: "The fixture card is test-only, Edge of the Universe's shape; the real Stinkyscape #148.1, held behind its set's gate (R1420), is answered once more at the end."
   - Append `mod r1843003_the_ai_answers_edge_of_the_universe` with `use super::*;` and the test `r1843003_the_ai_answers_edge_of_the_universes_radiant_prompt_and_wins`. It:
     1. calls `jackioh_cards::register_all()`;
     2. sets up `let mut s = scenario(json!({"seed": "r1843003-ai-edge", "p1": {"hand": [{"def": "stinkyscape-148-1", "radiant": true}], "library": ["core-053", "core-030"]}, "p2": {"library": ["core-053", "core-030"], "hand": ["core-005"]}}));`;
     3. plays it with `s.play("stinkyscape-148-1", json!({}))`;
     4. takes `let state = s.state().clone();`;
     5. copies the body of `r1843003_the_ai_answers_the_radiant_fleers_prompt_and_wins` (lines 118–154) from its `assert_eq!(state.pending…` onward, unchanged.

7. **`loc`.**
   - Run `cargo jackioh catalog loc crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c148_alteran_reach.rs` and write the number it prints into `stinkyscape-148`'s `"loc"`.
   - Do the same for `c148_1_edge_of_the_universe.rs` and `stinkyscape-148-1`.
   - Run it again after `cargo fmt`, since formatting can change the count.

## Tests

  - Use `preview_sets(&[SetName::Stinkyscape])` (L3 refuses a held set) and the same 24 Core ids plus `ID`.
  - Assert that both faces' `flags().quickdraw == Some(true)` and that the card is in p1's opening hand and not in the library.
- `r46_indestructible_a_destroy_leaves_it_on_the_field`: for both faces, Reach in p1's backrow, hand `["core-036", "core-005"]`, mana 4.
  - Play `core-036` with `{"targets": pick::instance(&reach)}`, then `expect_in_zone(&reach, "field")`.

Run:
```
cargo test -p jackioh-cards c148
cargo test -p jackioh-tools r1843002
cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai r1843003
cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 1000      # read the "endings:" line; fled may appear
```

## Done when

- [ ] Both stubs replaced. Each script returns only `Vec<Effect>` from prelude verbs and touches no state (rules 5 and 6).
- [ ] Every test above passes, base and Radiant, covering BUILD M12 rows S 148 and S 148.1.
- [ ] Both `loc` values match `catalog loc`, and no other catalog field changed.
- [ ] No file under `crates/cards/patches/` is added or changed; the golden traces are unchanged.
- [ ] `TERMINAL_REASONS` accepts `fled` and `fled-decisive`, and the fuzz test passes.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings`, the workspace test command with `apps/web/src/wire` clean, and `fuzz --seeds 200` are all green.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` is green, since the held set's cards count as no change.
- [ ] The PR notes say:
  - no ruling was added (R1847000–2 and R1843002–4 decide everything);
  - no §8.10, §7, BUILD M12, radiant-audit or catalog-text row was corrected;
  - the fuzz now accepts the two flight endings.

## Risks

- **Fuzz.** A random game with a Reach can travel 20 times and cast the Edge. Without step 5, the fuzz fails with `ended with reason "fled"`. Run 1,000 seeds to check, and replay any failing seed with `--from <seed> --seeds 1`. Never add a card to `POOL_EXCLUSIONS`.
- **Determinism and replay.** The map draws only from the match rng, inside the engine. The scripts hold no state.
- **Hidden information.** The Edge goes into hand hidden from the opponent; that is the engine's `add_to_hand`, so do not add events of your own.
- **The held gate.** Do not touch `SHIPPED_SETS`, pools or fragments. Only the Quickdraw test previews the set, through a guard scoped to that test.
- **`loc`.** The tools test fails if `loc` differs from the count. Recount it after any edit.
- **Glob clashes.** Prelude and testkit globs both name some items (`draw`, `damage`). Use the full paths given above (`jackioh_engine::effects::lose_health`, `jackioh_engine::subsystems::…`).
- **Card metrics.** Keep each script under 60 code lines (it is about 15), so neither joins `COMPLICATED` or `BUSTED`.

## Open questions

Decisions made here, each with the alternative rejected:
- **No new ruling.** ST-S23-1 restates R1847000 and R1847001. Rejected: a note `R1871000` that would duplicate them.
- **No `proven_in` or BUILD row edits.** These are hot spots that the parallel S parts edit on adjacent lines, and BUILD row S 148 is not wrong, only silent on Quickdraw, which the tests cover anyway. Rejected: listing the card files under R1847000–2 and R1843002–3, and adding a Quickdraw clause to row S 148.
- **Prompt words.** The Radiant prompt's options are "Draw" and "Loss", which zh-CN already translates, under the default "Choose one". Rejected: new strings plus `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` entries, which would pull the web app and the e2e smoke into a card part.
- **AI test with the real card.** Added in `crates/ai`, because the cards crate cannot call the practice AI and BUILD row S 148.1 names "the AI". Rejected: leaving that clause to the fixture alone.
- **Endings list.** Only the two flight endings are added. `voted-out` and `both-voted-out` wait for the Brains' part (S11), which makes them reachable.

For a person:
- **Duos.** `crates/engine/src/duos/reduce.rs` `result_now` makes a fled duel a win for the fleer's team and a loss for the other team. R1843004 says a seat's result is a draw. No shipped game reaches this before the release (#1884), and it belongs to #1843's mechanic, not this card part.
